description:
About this item
Durable: High-quality stainless steel blade and say goodbye to the trouble of rust. sharp and durable. Product dimensions 6.79 x 3.9 x 2.7 inches
Firmly fixed, no worry about grater slip during your job: Be careful! The finger gets hurt easily when the sharp blade you're using gets slipped! Our product is designed with an ergonomic handle and rubber base, which can efficiently avoid slipping during use and reduce the risk of finger cutting.
Easy to use: A wide range of different sharp blades help you grind a variety of foods efficiently, including cheese, vegetables, chocolate, and more.
Easy hand washing but also dishwasher safe: In the case of handwashing, you can simply clean it under running water. Please be aware that, we recommend you take the removable rubber base off before washing it. This will make sure you clean all the mess that may be hidden in the rubber base and farewell to the risk of any rust happening.
